message:
Let me check what fuzz targets are built and how to run them in the build environment.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'ls /gt/_work/src/fuzz/ && find / -maxdepth 4 -name "*valid*" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -20 && which clang gcc 2>/dev/null' 2>&1 | head -50</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
